a: A theme with no `header` band leaves the previous theme's `headerFill` on a header body
A text color set by hand freezes a header row's text, which that color never reaches
After a theme with `headerText`, an author's own fill never comes back to the header text
Theme edits can produce a theme that `diagramThemeFrom` then rejects, so the document drops back to `night`
`setDiagramFontSize` writes any number, including 0, negatives and NaN
`setDiagramColor('stroke')` adds a stroke to a shape drawn with none
b: Setting a header box's text color freezes its header row at the current theme's fill
A fill set under a theme with `headerText` leaves the header row stuck at that theme's headerText
Switching to a theme without `header` leaves the previous theme's header band color
setThemeValue writes any value at any path, so an edited theme can be applied but not read back
diagramThemeFrom silently falls back for an object without `roles`
setDiagramFontSize accepts sizes a theme step would clamp
setDiagramColor('stroke') on a shape with no stroke creates a width-less stroke
